content:
this seems like something that should not be a fail mode for the command, since that's what it's meant to help against.
Specifically, i got the following output:

$ lake clean
info: Version 4.2.2 of elan is available! Use `elan self update` to update.
info: downloading https://releases.lean-lang.org/lean4/v4.31.0-rc1/lean-4.31.0-rc1-windows.tar.zst
Error(Download(Msg("unable to write download to disk")), State { next_error: Some(Os { code: 112, kind: StorageFull, message: "There is not enough space on the disk." }), backtrace: InternalBacktrace { backtrace: None } })
error: could not download file from 'https://releases.lean-lang.org/lean4/v4.31.0-rc1/lean-4.31.0-rc1-windows.tar.zst' to 'C:\Users\edege\.elan\tmp\mww62e1iubmr303m_file'
info: caused by: unable to write download to disk
info: caused by: There is not enough space on the disk. (os error 112)

it's probably worse, it seems any invoking of lake tries to update, rather than just throwing a warning. It's understandable if lake commands would do nothing if they would actually add and/or modify things in the project, but imo lake or lake --help should just work, even if it thows a warning that the version is outdated.
